Protein Food

Anchovy

About This Entry

Fresh anchovy is delicate small fish — fried or marinated, distinct from cured anchovy paste. Light acidic whites and sherry flor styles complement.

Beginner Guide

Catalog entity is fresh whole anchovy — cured anchovy products are deferred.

FAQ

What is Anchovy?
Catalog entity is fresh whole anchovy — cured anchovy products are deferred.
How should Anchovy be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
